bio.text: Debbie Mayfield represents District 19 in the Florida Senate, to which Mayfield was elected on June 10, 2025; Mayfield also served in the Senate from 2016 to 2024.

Mayfield served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2008 to 2016 and again from 2024 to June 9, 2025. Mayfield was Senate Majority Leader from 2020 to 2022 and chaired the Senate Rules Committee from 2022 to 2024.
Mayfield is a retired banking executive, was born in Pensacola, Florida, and attended Santa Fe Community College and the Florida Banking School.
